Description:
Flooring Expert is an authorized distributor and premium solution partner for top-tier Indian and international interior surface brands. The business provides end-to-end consulting, material supply, and professional installation services for high-end residential, corporate, and commercial projects.

Authorized Brands & Partners:
- WELSPUN (Click-N-Lock SPC, MultiStile LVT, Premium Corporate Carpet Tiles)
- PARÉ (Innovative Wall & Ceiling Louvers, Facades, Core SPC, HDF Tough, LVT Flooring)
- BEKKER (German Engineered Wood, Luxury Laminate Flooring, Rigid SPC)
- CERA (Premium Sanitaryware, Luxury Faucets, Showers, and Wellness Solutions)
- MYK LATICRETE (Advanced Tile Adhesives, Industrial Grouts, and Stone Care Chemicals)
